description: Value and momentum are negatively correlated anomalies; blending them reduces drawdowns and improves risk-adjusted returns because when one factor crashes the other typically hedges it, so a 50/50 rank combination of 12-month momentum (skip 1 month) and book-to-market should yield higher forward Sharpe than either standalone; falsified if forward Sharpe is below the best existing 252d-skip-21 momentum strategy (currently 1.68).
title: Value-Momentum Blend · 252d skip 21 · Top 1000 · Long Only
